name: KY-009 RGB SMD LED
not_buildable: Each colour needs its own series resistor and an output pin. It is an output part, and LearnLens sketches may only switch the board's own LEDs so far.
identification: Small black PCB with a flat square white LED chip in the middle and 4 angled header pins labelled -, R, G, B.

facts.statement: Red, green and blue LED with a common cathode; forward voltage 1.8 V (red) and 2.8 V (green, blue) at 20 mA. The vendor lists series resistors of 180 ohm (red) and 100 ohm (green, blue).
facts.source: Joy-IT SensorKit, KY-009, technical data and series resistors
